tasks.title: Conversation #59
tasks.transcript:
Man: Are Alyssa and David back from studying abroad in Hong Kong?
Woman: Yes, they returned last week. Alyssa's still adjusting to the time difference.
Man: I can relate. I had bad jet lag last summer after travelling across the globe. I kept taking long naps which affected my sleep at night.
Woman: Yeah, instead of napping, getting outside for a walk and sunlight helps reset your internal clock. I told Alyssa the same.
Man: Once she's over it, let's all have lunch.
Woman: Sounds good. She just needs to sort out credit for an extra course she took over there, then she'll be free.

questions.stem: What was the woman's recommendation to Alyssa?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：女士给 Alyssa 的建议是什么？ 定位原文：Woman: Yeah, instead of napping, getting outside for a walk and sunlight helps reset your internal clock. I told Alyssa the same. 选项分析： A. Get natural light outside 到户外接触自然光。因为女士明确建议去户外散步和晒太阳来帮助调整生物钟，并说她也告诉了 Alyssa 同样的话，所以 A 选项正确。 B. Take a nap 睡午觉。因为女士建议不要睡午觉，所以 B 选项错误。 C. Avoid using an alarm clock 避免使用闹钟。因为对话中未提及闹钟，所以 C 选项错误。 D. Take a daytime flight 乘坐白天的航班。因为对话讨论的是倒时差的方法，未提及航班时间，所以 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: What does Alyssa need to do?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：Alyssa 需要做什么？ 定位原文：Woman: She just needs to sort out credit for an extra course she took over there, then she'll be free. 选项分析： A. Take an extra course 修一门额外的课程。因为 Alyssa 已经修完了这门课，现在需要处理的是学分问题，所以 A 选项错误。 B. Research other study abroad options 研究其他的留学选择。因为对话中未提及研究其他留学项目，所以 B 选项错误。 C. Transfer course credit 转换课程学分。由于女士提到 Alyssa 需要解决那门额外课程的学分问题，即进行学分转换或认证，所以 C 选项正确。 D. Review her travel plan 检查她的旅行计划。因为对话中未提及旅行计划，所以 D 选项错误。
